Author: PlatyDuckbill
Name: DuckbillFisher
Description:
Let Duckbill guide your next catch.
A fishing companion for FFXIV Korea.

• Browse fish with collection, region and availability filters.
• Plan spawns with a timeline and monthly calendar.
• Check baits, mooch chains and time/weather conditions.
• Prepare baits for favorites or filtered fish, with inventory counts.
• Find owned baits with page markers and in-game UI highlights.
• Open fishing spots directly on the map.
• Get local alerts for favorites, with optional sounds.
• See fish available now or soon in the quick list.
• Follow casts with a timer and personal fishing records.

Open: /dbfs or /duckbillfisher. /dbfs cl: compact list; /dbfs ct: casting timer.
UI: English / Korean. Game names follow your client.

Verified on the supported Korean client and Dalamud build only.
Does not automate fishing.
Punchline: Let Duckbill guide your next catch.
Changelog:
New feature · Spawn schedule
Plan your next fishing target with Timeline and Monthly calendar tabs.

• Search favorites or the main list's filtered fish, hide caught fish, and toggle Fish Eyes with its toolbar icon.
• Start with 3 hours or switch to 1, 3, 6, 12 or 24 hours. Fish icons and tighter rows show more targets.
• See spawn time and fish name by date; click for the full list, resize it, or hide it for a larger calendar.
• Open map pins and fish details directly from the schedule.
